Before I touch anything — what do you actually want here? "Sort out" could mean a few different things and I don't want to guess and start moving tickets around:

- Re-prioritize what's in it (reorder based on what's urgent now)
- Close out stale/duplicate tickets that shouldn't be there anymore
- Just re-tag/categorize so it's easier to scan
- Something else specific that's bugging you

Tell me which (or all three) and I'll go do it. If you just mean "make it less messy" generally, give me one example of what's annoying you in there right now and I'll use that as the pattern.
